UnitStatement: This document is the authoritative specification for Chirality App physical structures, file formats, schemas, runtime mechanics, session storage, validation surfaces, and layout conventions.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Normative keywords MUST, MUST NOT, SHOULD, SHOULD NOT, and MAY are used in their ordinary specification sense.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The instruction root is the release-managed resource set bundled with the desktop app or supplied through CHIRALITY_INSTRUCTION_ROOT during development.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: A complete source tree or packaged app instruction root requires entries including AGENTS.md, README.md, agents/, docs/, docs/DIRECTIVE.md, docs/CONTRACT.md, docs/SPEC.md, docs/TYPES.md, and docs/PLAN.md.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: docs/WHAT-IS-AN-AGENT.md and PROFESSIONAL_ENGINEERING.md are required instruction-root entries where required by packaging/integrity policy.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The instruction root is read-only during ordinary project execution.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Writes to the instruction root MUST be blocked by runtime hooks and path policy.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Packaged builds MUST verify instruction-root integrity.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Missing required instruction-root assets are a P0 packaging and runtime-readiness blocker.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The working root (projectRoot) is the user-selected local project folder.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The working root MUST be an absolute existing directory.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The working root MUST be readable and writable by the app.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The working root MUST NOT be inside the instruction root.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The working root contains project execution state, deliverables, tool roots, sessions, and local artifacts.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The working root is the ordinary location where agents and tools write project truth.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Runtime configuration state such as UI presets, API keys, provider/SDK linkage, adapter transcript cross-references, session metadata, and window layout is non-authoritative convenience state unless imported into a governed project file.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: An execution instance is rooted at {EXECUTION_ROOT}/ and contains package folders plus tool roots.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The execution root layout includes INIT.md, package folders PKG-XX_{PkgLabel}/, and tool-root folders such as _Aggregation/, _Change/, _Coordination/, _Decomposition/, _Estimates/, _Reconciliation/, _Archive/, _Scripts/, and _Sources/.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Package folders are named {PKG-ID}_{Sanitize(PackageName)}/.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Package folders MUST include the 1_Working/ subfolder for active deliverables.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Package folders SHOULD include 0_References/ and 0_References/_Archive/ for package-level and archived references.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Package folders SHOULD include 1_Working/_Archive/, 2_Checking/ with From/ and To/, and 3_Issued/ with _Archive/.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Tool roots include _Aggregation/ for aggregation snapshots and templates and _Change/ for change-management records.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Tool roots include _Coordination/, _Decomposition/, _Estimates/, _Reconciliation/, _Archive/ for baseline snapshots with checksums, _Scripts/, and _Sources/.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Snapshot-producing workflows SHOULD write timestamped immutable folders and MAY update _LATEST.md pointer files.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Each deliverable occupies {EXECUTION_ROOT}/{PKG-ID}_{PkgLabel}/1_Working/{DEL-ID}_{DelLabel}/.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: A deliverable MUST contain _STATUS.md (lifecycle state and history), _CONTEXT.md (identity, package, decomposition reference, traceability), _DEPENDENCIES.md (dependency summary and run history), and _REFERENCES.md (source references and hash notes).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: A deliverable SHOULD contain _SEMANTIC.md for the PREPARATION baseline as a semantic placeholder or lens.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: When initialized, a deliverable SHOULD contain Datasheet.md, Specification.md, Guidance.md, and Procedure.md.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Dependencies.csv SHOULD be present when tracked as a structured dependency register v3.1.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: MEMORY.md SHOULD be present as the canonical deliverable-local working memory.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: _MEMORY.md MUST NOT exist in this project profile; it is a disabled noncanonical memory file.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The minimum PREPARATION fileset is _STATUS.md, _CONTEXT.md, _DEPENDENCIES.md, _REFERENCES.md, and a _SEMANTIC.md placeholder.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The document kit consists of Datasheet.md, Specification.md, Guidance.md, and Procedure.md.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: _STATUS.md uses a defined markdown format with a status heading, Current State, Last Updated, and a History section.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The valid _STATUS.md state progression is OPEN -> INITIALIZED -> SEMANTIC_READY -> IN_PROGRESS -> CHECKING -> ISSUED.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: State OPEN means the folder exists with the minimum viable fileset; INITIALIZED means draft documents or document kit initialized.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: State SEMANTIC_READY means a semantic lens or placeholder is generated; IN_PROGRESS means human/agent work is underway.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: State CHECKING means under human review; ISSUED means released/issued by a human.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Transition to OPEN is authorized by PREPARATION/scaffold; OPEN to INITIALIZED by 4_DOCUMENTS or human.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: INITIALIZED to SEMANTIC_READY is authorized by CHIRALITY_FRAMEWORK or human; INITIALIZED or SEMANTIC_READY to IN_PROGRESS by human or WORKING_ITEMS.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: IN_PROGRESS to CHECKING and CHECKING to ISSUED are authorized by a human.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: _STATUS.md is the canonical lifecycle file.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: _STATUS.md transitions are forward-only unless a human explicitly amends the record.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Transitions to CHECKING or ISSUED require approval SHA evidence.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: SDK/MCP status-transition tools MUST enforce the lifecycle transition rules.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: _CONTEXT.md has a required structure including Name, Package, Discipline, Type, Responsible, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Anticipated Artifacts, Scope Traceability, and Decomposition Reference.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: _CONTEXT.md header fields SHOULD match the accepted decomposition.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: _CONTEXT.md is created by PREPARATION/scaffold and is human-maintained thereafter.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: _DEPENDENCIES.md is a hybrid container with human-owned and agent/tool-owned sections: Dependency Tracking Mode, Declared Upstream, Declared Downstream, Extracted Dependency Register, Lifecycle Summary, Run Notes, and Run History.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Dependency tracking mode NOT_TRACKED means dependencies are coordinated externally by humans.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Dependency tracking mode DECLARED means human-declared upstream/downstream only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Dependency tracking mode TRACKED means full extraction via dependency workflow and Dependencies.csv.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: _REFERENCES.md has a required structure with Applicable References (RefName/ID, Location, Relevance, ContentHash) and Notes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: _REFERENCES.md ContentHash is a 64-char lowercase SHA-256, or TBD, or an ERROR with reason.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Reference paths SHOULD be relative where practical.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Out-of-folder references SHOULD include ContentHash when tooling is available.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Hash bypasses require human approval and durable bypass records.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: MEMORY.md is the canonical deliverable-local working memory file organized by semantic topic then chronologically.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: MEMORY.md sections include Key Decisions & Human Rulings, Domain Context, Open Items, Proposal History, and Interface & Dependency Notes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: _MEMORY.md MUST NOT be created in this project profile.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Every Dependencies.csv row MUST include RegisterSchemaVersion set to v3.1.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Dependencies.csv MUST include RegisterSchemaVersion (v3.1), DependencyID unique within the register, FromPackageID, FromDeliverableID, and FromDeliverableName.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: DependencyClass MUST be ANCHOR or EXECUTION; Direction MUST be UPSTREAM or DOWNSTREAM.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: AnchorType, DependencyType, and TargetType are MUST enum columns defined in TYPES.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Optional target columns include TargetPackageID, TargetDeliverableID, TargetRefID, and TargetLocation; TargetName SHOULD be a human-readable target.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: EvidenceFile and SourceRef are conditionally required columns holding source filename and path-plus-heading, or 'location TBD'.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: EvidenceQuote SHOULD be a short quote of no more than 30 words; Explicitness SHOULD be EXPLICIT or IMPLICIT.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: SatisfactionStatus SHOULD record closure status; Confidence SHOULD be HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Origin MUST be DECLARED or EXTRACTED; FirstSeen and LastSeen MUST be ISO dates; Status MUST be ACTIVE or RETIRED.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Extension columns MAY be present and are non-breaking, including EstimateImpactClass and ConsumerHint.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: DependencyID MUST be unique within a deliverable register.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FromDeliverableID MUST match the host deliverable ID.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: ANCHOR rows use IMPLEMENTS_NODE or TRACES_TO_REQUIREMENT with DependencyType=OTHER.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: EXECUTION rows use AnchorType=NOT_APPLICABLE.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Dependency rows are retired, not deleted.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Legacy missing RegisterSchemaVersion is normalized on write to v3.1.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Agent instruction files use AGENT_*.md names.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Agent instruction files require a header with [[DOC:AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS]], an AGENT INSTRUCTIONS title, and AGENT_TYPE set to 0, 1, or 2.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The required Agent Type table includes AGENT_TYPE, AGENT_CLASS (PERSONA or TASK), INTERACTION_SURFACE (chat, INIT-TASK, spawned, or both), WRITE_SCOPE, BLOCKING (never or allowed), and PRIMARY_OUTPUTS.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Agent instruction files require section markers PROTOCOL, SPEC, STRUCTURE, and RATIONALE delimited by [[BEGIN:X]] and [[END:X]].
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Agent instruction section precedence is PROTOCOL > SPEC > STRUCTURE > RATIONALE.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Machine-consumed YAML frontmatter MAY include description, subagents, tools, model, max_turns, disallowed_tools, and auto_approve_tools.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Runtime MUST treat UI visibility of an option as non-authoritative; governance and permission policy remain authoritative.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Legacy sessions may exist as {sessionRoot}/{sessionId}.json.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Current legacy session fields include sessionId, projectRoot, persona, mode, createdAt, updatedAt, engineSessionId, claudeSessionId, bootFingerprint, bootedAt, and model.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Legacy session records MUST remain readable during migration.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The canonical vNext session layout is .chirality/sessions/<sessionId>/ containing session.json, events.jsonl, turns/<turnId>.json, artifacts/, and sdk/.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: CHIRALITY_SESSION_ROOT is an optional override for the session root.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: session.json SHOULD include sessionId, projectRoot, persona, mode, createdAt, updatedAt, model, bootFingerprint, and engineSessionId.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: session.json SHOULD include SDK linkage fields sdkSessionId, sdkProjectKey, sdkTranscriptPath or sdkSessionStoreKey, sdkConfigDir, sdkSettingSources, sdkPackageVersion, sdkClaudeCodeVersion, and sdkResumeMode.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: events.jsonl is the product-owned Chirality audit mirror.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: SDK transcripts are secondary runtime state unless imported into HarnessEvent form.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The product SHOULD prefer SDK transcript placement or mirroring under the working root or parent project-controlled folder using SessionStore, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, or both when reliable.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: If the SDK writes under ~/.claude/projects/..., Chirality MUST cross-reference the path or store key, keep events.jsonl canonical, and record residual risk in the reliance-boundary register.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: HarnessEvent has fields schemaVersion (1), eventId, sessionId, optional turnId, optional parentEventId, timestamp, type, and data as a record.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: JSONL writes MUST append newline-delimited events in write sequence.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Event IDs MUST be unique.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Secrets MUST NOT be stored in events.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Large payloads MUST be stored as artifacts and referenced by path.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Replay MUST ignore malformed trailing lines and surface diagnostics.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Event schema evolution MUST be backward-compatible or explicitly versioned.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Initial event categories include session.created, session.resumed, turn.accepted, turn.started, adapter.initialized, model.request.started, model.delta, model.completed, turn.completed, turn.failed, and turn.cancelled.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Later event categories include tool.queued, tool.permission, tool.started, tool.progress, tool.completed, tool.failed, hook.started, hook.completed, context.compacted, subagent.started, subagent.completed, and runtime.mirror.error.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Chirality MUST define an AgentEnginePort / RuntimeEngineContract separate from provider/SDK APIs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The runtime engine's target responsibilities include accepting validated turn input, persisting turn.accepted before adapter/model execution, yielding browser UIEvents, and persisting canonical HarnessEvents.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The runtime engine's target responsibilities include enforcing or invoking permission decisions, exposing only permitted tools, linking adapter session metadata, handling interrupt/cancel behavior, and persisting terminal outcomes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: AgentEnginePort defines runTurn(input: TurnInput) returning AsyncIterable<UIEvent> and an optional interrupt(sessionId) returning Promise<void>.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: TurnInput MUST include the active session, normalized project root, persona, mode, resolved runtime options, content blocks, attachment summaries, and cancellation signal where applicable.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Provider/SDK messages are not the browser contract and not the canonical persisted event contract.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Provider/SDK-specific names and IDs appear only as adapter metadata.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: EngineAdapter MUST translate external message names, session IDs, tool names, permission modes, transcript paths, and hook names into Chirality-owned contracts.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Provider-specific values MAY be retained under explicit adapter metadata fields.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Any provider/SDK-backed adapter MUST pass engine conformance tests before production default use.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The current Claude Agent SDK / Anthropic adapter is the first concrete adapter and current shipped path.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: A stub adapter remains available for deterministic tests.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: /api/harness/turn remains a transport adapter that validates request shape, obtains session lock, forwards input to TurnEngine, writes SSE, and handles cleanup, and does not own runtime policy.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Turn streams emit named SSE events with JSON payloads: session:init, chat:delta, chat:complete, tool:result, session:complete, turn:error, and process:exit.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Existing SSE event names MUST remain compatible during SDK adoption.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Additional tool progress events MAY be introduced only with UI compatibility handling.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The stream MUST terminate with a process-level completion/error signal unless the client disconnects.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Client disconnect cleanup MUST record cancellation once the event log exists.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Chirality uses a provider-adapter runtime architecture with Claude Agent SDK / Anthropic as the first concrete adapter and current shipped path, subject to R0/R1 empirical verification and ongoing conformance tests.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Concrete non-Anthropic providers require bounded future implementation scope.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Shipped builds MUST use settingSources: [].
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Development-only project settings MAY use ['project'] behind explicit environment configuration.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: User and local setting sources MUST NOT be used in shipped builds.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: API key precedence is UI safeStorage key first, then ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, then CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Key material is supplied to the provider/SDK environment only as needed for active turns and redacted from logs/events.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Safe adapter runtime metadata SHOULD include provider/SDK package version, Claude Code subprocess version where knowable, provider/SDK permission mode, visible tool list, MCP server names, settings-source posture, provider/SDK session ID and resume mode, and transcript/store linkage.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SPEC -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Required hooks include symlink write rejection, write budget enforcement, and provenance append where policy requires.
